name: Asistent detektiva Zbyška 2 - Vražda v Orion expresu
source: The story of detective Zbyšek and his team continues. In this episode Zbyšek and his assistant will be solving a difficult case full of political motives. The citizens of city of Regenbogen are on their traditional trip to Orion's belt, where votes will be cast for new king and queen. This time the mood is full of tension, because known activist Alfaba wants to take the ruling post for herself at any cost. In game of intrigues and hidden secrets that ensues, Gabrielle's past will be revealed with many others. In corridors of space express you will witness great panic and fear from the worst situation ever - LOSS OF LUGGAGE!
translation: 兹比谢克侦探和他的团队的故事仍在继续。在本集中，兹比谢克和他的助手将解决一个充满政治动机的疑难案件。雷根博根市的市民正在进行传统的猎户座腰带之旅，在那里投票选出新国王和王后。这次气氛充满紧张，因为著名的激进分子阿尔法巴想不惜一切代价为自己夺取执政职位。在随之而来的阴谋和隐藏秘密的游戏中，加布里埃尔的过去将与许多其他人一起被揭露。在太空快车的走廊里，你将目睹有史以来最糟糕的情况带来的巨大恐慌和恐惧 - 行李丢失！
